# Floor 1 furniture fit (generated by tools/fit_floor1.py)

Standard kit, the same for every student: bed, Tinker side table, Twill wardrobe, Compact study table and chair. Twin rooms (ROOM-1, ROOM-2, ROOM-3): **two students, each with their own bed, desk + chair and wardrobe** (Centaur single beds, at least 1'-0" apart; shared Tinker in ROOM-3). Other rooms: one student (Orion queen). Every item sits flush on a plain wall (never on a column); matching items line up on one wall or face each other. Clearances: bed open side 1'-11 5/8", wardrobe front 1'-11 5/8", chair pull-out 2'-5 1/2", walking path 1'-9 5/8".
